prompt:
Subject: stewardess, target meaning "スチュワーデス".

Composition: Show a friendly flight attendant in a neat uniform handing a small tray to a seated passenger, with a rounded airplane window beside them.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use only the attached invidious.png as drawing-style reference. Clean smooth solid color fills and a few flat cartoon shadow shapes. Every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and hands; hands and wrists connect naturally to sleeves and shoulders. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows.
en: The stewardess hands a meal tray to the passenger.
ja: 客室乗務員が乗客に食事のトレーを渡している。
